description: This file defines API endpoints for managing vector stores, including creation, listing, deletion, information retrieval, and updating. It uses FastAPI framework with dependencies, models, and registry management related to vector stores.

classes.name: LiteLLM_ManagedVectorStore
classes.description: Data model representing a managed vector store, used for create and update operations.

classes.name: LiteLLM_ManagedVectorStoreListResponse
classes.description: Response model listing multiple vector stores with pagination info.

classes.name: ResponseLiteLLM_ManagedVectorStore
classes.description: Response model returning details of a single vector store.

classes.name: VectorStoreDeleteRequest
classes.description: Request model for deleting a vector store by ID.

classes.name: VectorStoreInfoRequest
classes.description: Request model for fetching information of a specific vector store.

classes.name: VectorStoreUpdateRequest
classes.description: Request model for updating vector store details.

methods.name: new_vector_store( vector_store: LiteLLM_ManagedVectorStore, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Endpoint to create a new vector store and add it to the registry.

methods.name: list_vector_stores( user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), page: int = 1, page_size: int = 100, )
methods.description: Endpoint to list all vector stores with pagination, combining in-memory and database sources.

methods.name: delete_vector_store( data: VectorStoreDeleteRequest, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Endpoint to delete a vector store both from database and registry.

methods.name: get_vector_store_info( data: VectorStoreInfoRequest, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve details of a specific vector store, checking in registry and database.

methods.name: update_vector_store( data: VectorStoreUpdateRequest, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Endpoint to update vector store information in database and registry.

ctags.name: list_vector_stores
ctags.signature: ( user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), page: int = 1, page_size: int = 100, )
